question: How are the twenty-eight cities arranged in the eyes?
premises: twenty-eight cities are in two eyes
three cities come from puruṣa at night
two are less by one third angula
inference: The cities are arranged in order with specified angula reductions.
plain_english: Thus twenty-eight cities are in two eyes; three cities come from puruṣa at night, two are less by one-third angula, in order.
